name: seo-writers
description: An evidence-safe editorial workflow with scoped coordination, specialist delegation, selective reruns, and independent final reader review for SEO articles.

interface.longDescription: Run or resume a stateful workflow to plan, draft, edit, independently audit, illustrate, selectively recheck revisions, and hand off SEO articles with explicit evidence and publication boundaries.
defaultPrompt: Run or resume the complete SEO article workflow from my current inputs.
Audit a topic against my content library before drafting.
Draft an evidence-safe article from an approved Article Brief.
